name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Air Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): An Air Elemental appears in the space nearest the censer. It obeys you and takes its turn right after yours, and it's gone after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it.

powers.name: Dismiss the elemental
powers.text: Bonus Action: send back the Air Elemental you called with the censer.

summary: Once a day, call an Air Elemental that obeys you for up to 1 hour.
text: Take a Magic action with the censer to call an Air Elemental into the unoccupied space nearest it. The elemental understands your languages, does as you command, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It's gone after 1 hour, when it drops to 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The censer can't call another until the next dawn.
